title: Existence of Ramsey numbers
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $k$ and $l$, there exists a natural number $n$ with the following property: every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique of size $k$ or an independent set of size $l$.
hypotheses_covered: k and l range over arbitrary natural numbers
conclusion: existence of an n witnessing the Ramsey bound
replaced:
For all $k$ and $l$ there is an $n$ such that every graph on $n$ vertices contains
a $k$-clique or an $l$-independent set.
